dedupe_keys.name: innovapower three phase squirrel cage induction generator fault signals

description: The SCIG-3phase-Dataset contains InnovaPower laboratory measurements from a squirrel-cage induction generator under healthy and deliberately faulted operating conditions. The University of São Paulo team lists it as a separate resource from its permanent-magnet and conventional synchronous-generator datasets. The inspected folder contains 225 MATLAB files and Python visualization support. Filenames encode faulted turns, resistance, speed and torque, while the parent README identifies time, electrical signals and mechanical measurements. The data are freely accessible under CC BY 4.0 and have a separately identified Zenodo release. Geographic coverage is a controlled Brazilian test bench, not a wind-farm monitoring network; the root documentation does not establish a calendar observation period. Fault insertion and operating-point selection limit transfer to real fleet failure rates. A reviewer-assessed use is testing generator fault-detection or reduced condition models for power-system resilience simulations. model-pandapower is a related network model, but no coupling or signal-processing run was performed.
